## Install

1. Download **private-wa-tools.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.
4. Open or reload web.whatsapp.com.

To update, unzip over the old folder, click the reload arrow on the extension card, and reload WhatsApp Web.

**Help wanted:** deleted message recovery does not work yet. [How to help](https://github.com/DhananjayBhosale/private-wa-tools/blob/main/docs/deleted-message-recovery.md).
